description: Independent synthetic benchmark for OpenPoke workflow-relative routing; 200 stored internal workflows + 200 labeled user requests. Generated and reviewed for schema/consistency, but not independently human-blind-labeled.

label_policy.scope: OpenPoke internal workflow identity, not existence or lifecycle of external cases/emails/documents
label_policy.RESUME: Continue exactly one identifiable stored internal workflow that covers all requested tasks.
label_policy.CREATE: Actionable task with no corresponding stored internal workflow, including references to externally existing objects, or a distinct new task scope.
label_policy.CLARIFY: Insufficient task identity, multiple plausible existing workflows, multiple independent workflows beyond current single-route contract, or user explicitly requires an unavailable internal workflow.
label_policy.intent_field: Linguistic/request-level intent hint; continue may refer to an external task, and does not imply an existing internal OpenPoke workflow.
label_policy.task_type_hint: Oracle hint extracted from the user request where identifiable; not intended as a prediction label.

generation.split_policy: 40 dev / 160 holdout; RESUME cases grouped by target workflow, deterministic seed
generation.privacy: Entirely fictional; no actual user emails or account data
limits: One workflow per routing decision; multi-target requests marked CLARIFY until multi-route supported
All workflows active and belong to one evaluation user; no archived-state cases
Synthetic test; not representative production traffic; label disputes need manual review
Changing action labels changes semantics; do not compare v1 accuracy with v2 without re-running both baselines
